headline: Customer Success Manager
summary: Customer success manager with nine years in SaaS and BPO support, now leading a team that looks after 140 business clients of a payroll software company. I own onboarding, renewals and client health, work in Salesforce and HubSpot, and use data to spot at-risk accounts early. I keep a client-first mindset while hitting retention targets.
highlights: Raised gross revenue retention from 86% to 94% over two years.
Designed a 30-day onboarding program that halved time to first payroll run.
Built an account health score from usage and support data that flags churn risk three months ahead.

experience.title: Customer Success Manager
bullets: Lead five customer success associates managing 140 business clients.
Run quarterly business reviews with key clients and plan renewals with sales.
Report client health and retention to the leadership team every month.

experience.title: Customer Success Associate
bullets: Onboarded new clients and trained their HR staff on the software.
Managed renewals for 60 small business accounts.

experience.title: Customer Service Team Leader
bullets: Led 15 agents on an inbound account and reviewed their calls against quality standards.
Analysed call volumes and staffing to cut abandoned calls.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Business Administration, major in Management
